jobs.description:
Data-Warehouse GmbH is an expanding software manufacturer and service provider. Over the last 20 years the company has developed into a system house with its own product portfolios in the area of holistic, high quality information management, information logistics and process optimisation, security and cyber strategy and compliance/data protection consulting.

The job is a Senior Container Administrator role.  The environment to be managed is an air-gapped on-prem solution.  The expectation is that the candidate will also perform Unix/Linux administration activities.

The job is located in the north of Munich (on site as no remote working is possible).

German, British, Spanish or Italian nationality is required.

Tasks:

- Deploy, configure, and maintain Rancher-based container platform in an air-gapped environment.
- Manage Kubernetes clusters, nodes, and workloads within the Rancher ecosystem.
- Administer Unix-based operating systems, including performance tuning and troubleshooting.
- Implement security hardening practices for containerized environments and Unix servers.
- Automate system and container operations using scripting languages such as Ansible.
- Ensure high availability, fault tolerance, and disaster recovery for containerized workloads.
- Design and implement monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions for both Rancher and Unix infrastructure.
- Collaborate with DevOps and development teams to support CI/CD pipelines and deployment workflows.
- Maintain compliance with security policies, including patch management and vulnerability remediation.
- Document architecture, procedures, and operational guidelines for system administration.

Requirements/Knowledge/Experience:
- Proven experience in Rancher container orchestration and Kubernetes administration.
- Strong expertise in Unix/Linux system administration (RHEL8, RHEL9, or similar).
- Knowledge of air-gapped deployments and best practices for secure environments.
- Proficiency in infrastructure automation using Ansible, Terraform, or similar tools.
- Hands-on experience with monitoring tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, or Loki.
- Strong troubleshooting and performance tuning skills for both containers and Unix systems.
- Familiarity with container security tools and practices.
- Experience working with containerized databases and persistent storage solutions.
- Experience with version control and CI/CD pipelines (Git, Jenkins, ArgoCD, etc.).
- Certifications such as CKA (Certified Kubernetes Administrator), RHCE (Red Hat Certified Engineer), or similar is an advantage.
- Understanding of SIEM tools and security event monitoring focused on containers is an advantage.
- Working with ticket system for incidents, problems, change management and configuration management.
- Strong background in IT (working in IT).
- IT related Bachelor or Master’s degree is a plus.
- Any knowledge of ITIL would be useful.
- Knowledge of DNS and load balancers.
- Good Unix/Linux knowledge.
- Knowledge of BMC Helix would be nice to have.
- VMWare knowledge would be nice to have.
- The candidate should also be able to speak and write in English.
- Security check (Ü2) available or willing to go through the process to acquire it.
- Willingness to learn and acquire new skills (including acquiring relevant certifications).

Willingness to work in a rotation system (to cover the service hours) and to work outside working hours (usually one Saturday per month)

Your Soft Skills:

High team spirit

Reliability, punctuality

Our offer:

We offer a safe, trustful and long-term working environment with very good working conditions in an exciting working environment

Company fitness and other company events

Clear and open internal communications and fast decisions

Cultural and international mixture of leading experts in their areas

Highly innovative environment with a personal development plan

We look forward to welcoming you to our team and shaping the future.

- Experience & Skills- Several years of hands-on experience in sales, business development, partner success, marketplace seller success, or strategic account management in a B2B technology, software, SaaS, or digital platform environment- Proven ability to identify and qualify commercial opportunities, build success plans, and support joint sales activities within a partner ecosystem- Data-driven mindset, with experience using sales, pipeline, and marketplace insights to prioritize actions, forecast potential, and improve performance- Strong communication, persuasion, and negotiation skills, with the ability to manage multiple marketplace seller relationships and connect external portfolios with Siemens or comparable industrial technology propositions

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES The What: At Blackwave GmbH, we develop and manufacture high-performance carbon fiber components for airplanes, rockets, and satellites — pushing the limits of lightweight design and precision manufacturing. Our mission: To end COPV failure in spaceflight. The benchmark for performance, reliability and cost efficiency.

The Why: Because quality is the foundation of innovation. Every component we deliver must perform flawlessly under extreme conditions — in the air, in orbit, and beyond. As part of our Quality team, you ensure that our processes meet the highest standards, enabling us to turn cutting-edge ideas into flight-ready solutions.

Important Note: This role is focused on Quality Assurance of our hardware (COPVs). We are not currently hiring for Software Quality Assurance positions

• Project & Process Quality Assurance: You define and implement quality assurance strategies across the entire product lifecycle - from suppliers and development to serial production.
• Manufacturing & Process Quality: You accompany production on the shop floor, working closely with manufacturing teams to ensure quality requirements are effectively implemented at all production stations.
• Change Control: You support product and process changes, ensure quality requirements are considered and contribute to approval and implementation activities.
• Root Cause Analysis & Corrective Actions: You analyze quality deviations using structured methods (e.g. 8D, Ishikawa, 5-Why), derive sustainable corrective actions, and ensure their implementation.
• Continuous Improvement & Audits: You monitor key quality indicators (e.g. audit findings, non-conformities) and proactively drive continuous improvement of processes and standards.

YOUR PROFILE
• Training & studies - You have completed degree in engineering, quality management, production technology, or a comparable qualification
• Professional experience - You have relevant experience in quality planning and risk management, ideally in a manufacturing environment
• Analytical Thinking & Root Cause Analysis: You are skilled at identifying patterns, isolating root causes (e.g. using 8D, 5-Why, Ishikawa), and translating findings into actionable improvements
• Standards & Compliance Knowledge: You are familiar with applicable quality standards and their practical implementation, as well as experience with ISO9001
• Working Style & Mindset: You work independently, think in solutions, and enjoy deriving insights from quality data. You pursue excellence and value precision and reliability
• Language skills - Very good written and spoken English, German is also nice to have for collaboration between departments

WHAT WE OFFER
• Personal responsibility & creative freedom: You actively contribute to the further development of our production technologies.
• Flexible working hours & mobile working: Work-life balance is not an empty promise with us.
• Start-up spirit meets aerospace: flat hierarchies, short decision-making processes and room for innovation.
• Individual benefits: Choose between a Germany ticket, Egym-Wellpass or a tax-free benefit in kind with the Give Card.
• Fresh food every day: Shared lunch break with healthy, varied dishes.
• Alpine view included: Our roof terrace invites you to relax after work.
• Further development guaranteed: You will grow both professionally and personally through exciting projects and exchanges with experts.
• We live and breathe team culture: whether it's a tech talk, team event or after-work - we celebrate successes together.

About us Blackwave designs, manufactures and ships flight-qualified, commercial off-the-shelf composite overwrapped pressure vessels (COPVs) for launch vehicles and satellites. Founded in 2016 and headquartered in Munich, Germany, the company delivers COPVs from a standardized portfolio with flight heritage. The approach reduces lead time from months to days while ensuring that each tank is qualified and flight-ready. Blackwave's mission is to end COPV failure in spaceflight. The company employs more than 150 people across manufacturing facilities in Germany and Texas.More information at Blackwave.com and the procurement platform COPV.com.

jobs.description:
With a passion for life

Join our diverse teams of passionate people and a career that allows you to develop both personally and professionally. At Getinge we exist to make life-saving technology accessible for more people. To make a true difference for our customers—and to save more lives, we need team players, forward thinkers, and game changers.
Are you looking for an inspiring career? You just found it.

Be part of Getinge as a

Quality Management Engineer (m/f/d) QMS and Compliance

We are currently looking for an experienced Quality Management Engineer (m/f/d) QMS and Compliance to join our Quality department in Aschheim-Dornach, Germany, or Solna, Sweden, part of the Critical Care product area at Getinge. This role will support the organization as the internal audit process owner, CAPA coordinator, and QA specialist, while continuously improving our quality management system and supporting quality-related projects (e.g., implementation of new tools, CAPA, etc.).

Tasks & Responsibilities:

- Own the internal audit process, plan the annual internal audit schedule, and follow up on internal audit findings
- Conduct internal audits as an internal auditor
- Support of external audits (notified bodies, authorities, customers)
- Support of CAPA projects as CAPA coordinator
- Collaboration in and owning internal Quality projects (management system plan, CAPA)
- Continuous contribution to process improvement and alignment with other Critical Care sites
- Provision and reporting of monthly KPIs
- Maintenance, review and approval of QMS-related documentation and records as QA specialist

Desired Profile:

- Degree in medical technology, engineering, science, or a similar relevant field
- Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience in quality and environmental management, ideally in an ISO 13485 environment
- Relevant knowledge of the implementation and application of applicable standards and regulations
- Proven external and/or internal training in QM / ISO 13485 / FDA / EU MDR
- Ideally trained as an Internal Auditor
- Demonstrated experience in Quality- and Environmental-related projects (e.g., CAPAs, EU MDR uplift) is an advantage
- Fluency in written and spoken English; Swedish or German (depending on the location) is an advantage
- On-site presence of at least 1–2 days per week is expected; willingness to travel is required

In addition to your technical expertise, we highly value your personality. We believe you are a result-oriented and collaborative team player who takes ownership of your work and can operate independently when needed. You have strong analytical skills, a pragmatic mindset, and the ability to build relationships with stakeholders across different functions, seniority levels, and cultures. You thrive in a changing environment and approach challenges with professionalism and diplomacy.

We think you have an ambition for continuous development and a strong interest in staying up to date with the latest trends, regulations, and best practices within Quality Management, Medical Devices, and Supplier Quality.

At Getinge, we see ourselves as Team Players, Forward Thinkers, and Game Changers. We value proactive individuals who contribute to continuous improvement and organizational development.

Why join Getinge

We offer a competitive compensation and benefits package, including wellness allowances, generous family benefits, and joint company activities. Everything to ensure we support your well-being and goals.

Most importantly, this is a role where you can truly make a difference by contributing to the quality and safety of life-saving medical devices while helping shape the future of quality and compliance within Getinge.

Application

Applications will be reviewed continuously, and we therefore recommend submitting your application as soon as possible.

We kindly ask you to submit your application through our recruitment system by clicking the "Apply Now" button. Due to GDPR regulations, we do not accept applications via email.

About us

With a firm belief that every person and community should have access to the best possible care, Getinge provides hospitals and life science institutions with products and solutions aiming to improve clinical results and optimize workflows. The offering includes products and solutions for intensive care, cardiovascular procedures, operating rooms, sterile reprocessing, and life science. Getinge employs over 12,000 people worldwide, and the products are sold in more than 135 countries.

Reasonable accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

- You have a genuine passion for talent and recruiting.
- You leverage your strong communication skills to attract talented individuals to Bain.
- You have a strong service orientation and a genuine enthusiasm for daily interaction with candidates and Bainies.
- You look forward to taking on responsibility and independently driving topics forward.

Basic skills in Power BI, Alteryx, and/or Power Query or other data mining tools are a plus

Responsibility includes the safe, efficient, and cost-effective planning and execution of projects at site ON1. The position requires excellent organizational skills to ensure that logistics projects are completed on time and meet the highest quality standards.

In Neuenburg am Rhein, two new logistics centers with more than 90,000 sqm of warehouse space are currently being built. For our Operations Center 1 (30,000 sqm), we are looking for a Site Coordinator / Operations Project Manager for operational logistics.

Deine Aufgaben

- Overall responsibility for small and medium-sized logistics projects, ensuring successful implementation
- During the concept phase, conducting detailed research, analysis, and cost calculations. Preparing decision-relevant information for the Site Lead and presenting it clearly and convincingly
- In the implementation phase, ensuring smooth coordination and collaboration between all involved and affected departments. Managing internal and external stakeholders, resource and timeline planning, as well as project controlling to guarantee target achievement and performance monitoring
- Actively contributing to solution development by combining analytical and technical expertise to create added value
- Supporting other project managers in additional projects and leading sub-projects outside of ON1 when required

Deine Fähigkeiten

- Strong analytical skills, supported by relevant education or further training in Project Management, Facility Management, or Supply Chain Management
- A technical background with initial experience as a project manager, ideally in logistics and/or infrastructure projects
- A solution-oriented and pragmatic mindset, combined with hands-on involvement to drive projects to success
- The ability to communicate openly and effectively with different stakeholders, bringing discussions and differing opinions to a shared consensus
- Very good written and spoken communication skills in German or French, as well as English
- Taking calculated risks to create value and drive growth

- More benefits: 28 days of holiday, exclusive employee conditions in our online shop, a shuttle service and other benefits.

Diversity is our culture.

To build the best team, we want to draw from the full spectrum of talent out there. This means people from all walks of life have the same opportunities with us, regardless of their ethnicity, religion, disability status, gender identity, sexual orientation or age. We believe true inclusion means everyone is welcome and each contribution is valuable.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections,  where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come.

Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

At Roche, we believe precision medicine radically improves lives. Our Global CAP/CLIA laboratories are the "heartbeat" of diagnostic innovation, bridging the gap between early research and life-saving commercial diagnostics. As a Laboratory Manager, you aren't just overseeing a facility; you are leading a team that transforms complex biological data into the insights clinicians need to treat patients with cancer and other life-altering diseases.

We are seeking a high-caliber Laboratory Manager (m/f/d) to oversee our dual-specialty pathology and immunoassay laboratory. This role requires a unique blend of technical expertise in tissue-based diagnostics and immunoassay automated testing.

You will be responsible for the operational excellence of the lab, ensuring that both the Histology/Pathology and Immunoassay/Chemistry departments function at peak efficiency while maintaining total compliance with ISO15189, CAP (College of American Pathologists) and CLIA regulations.

The Opportunity

You will oversee a dual-specialty laboratory at the forefront of the industry. Your leadership will span two critical domains:
* Anatomic Pathology: Managing high-complexity tissue-based diagnostics, including advanced Immunohistochemistry (IHC) and In Situ Hybridization (ISH)
* Immunoassay Excellence: Driving peaks of operational efficiency in our automated immunoassay tracks on state-of-the-art cobas® platforms

You will also be a key driver in our Digital Pathology transformation, integrating whole-slide imaging and AI-based image analysis into routine clinical workflows to set new standards for diagnostic precision. Your key responsibilities:

* Visionary Operational Leadership: Supervise the daily "rhythm" of the lab, synchronizing pathology and immunoassay workflows to ensure competitive turnaround times (TAT)
* Guardian of Quality: Maintain an "inspection-ready" culture, serving as the primary lead for CAP/CLIA and ISO 15189 audits
* Champion of People: Lead, mentor, and inspire team of Laboratory scientists, fostering a culture of continuous learning and technical excellence
* Strategic Technical Oversight: Manage the validation and implementation of new assays and novel platforms, ensuring every piece of equipment is a high-performing component of our diagnostic system
* Innovate & Improve: Actively identify opportunities for workflow optimization and cost-effective management without ever compromising the quality that defines the Roche name

Who you are
* You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Clinical Laboratory Science, Medical Technology, or a related Biological Science. A Master’s (MHA/MBA) or PhD is highly preferred.
* Furthermore, you have 5+ years of experience in a clinical laboratory setting
* Proven expertise in both anatomic pathology and automated immunoassay workflows is a distinct advantage
* The ideal candidate isn't just a technical expert; You are a leader who fosters a culture of quality, safety, and continuous improvement with at least 2 years of experience in a leadership role
* You live the Roche mindset by maintaining a track record of zero-deficiency inspections and a passion for navigating the complexities of emerging global regulations

Your Application 

Please submit your updated CV. References and certificates are not required at this stage. Please apply with English application documents. 

Please note that no additional documents can be submitted after your application has been sent.

We look forward to receiving your application and potentially welcoming you to our team!

 

 

Your contact to us! With people. For people.

Do you need further support?

Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq.

Who we are

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
